name: App

description.zh: 为窗口建立主题与组件环境。
description.en: Set up the theme and component environment for a window.

guide.zh: 在窗口视图中先调用 nui.App，取得供子组件使用的主题。这里用 Card 和 Button 展示同一主题下的组合；完整示例包含语言、色板和窗口初始化。
guide.en: Call nui.App in the window view and pass the resulting theme to child components. This example combines a Card and Button; the complete program includes language, palette and window setup.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

body: nui.Card(c.Key("card"), t, nui.CardOptions{Title: "NuxtUI Go", Description: "Window theme and component defaults"}, func() { nui.Button(c.Key("save"), t, {{label}}, nui.ButtonOptions{AccessibleLabel: cmp.Or({{label}}, "Example action"), Color: {{color}}}) })

name: Theme

description.zh: 组合色板、局部主题与组件默认样式。
description.en: Compose palettes, local themes and component defaults.

guide.zh: 第一个按钮使用局部组件主题，第二个用实例颜色覆盖它，第三个通过 UI 调整圆角和水平内边距。修改颜色、尺寸和样式，比较全局主题、局部默认值与实例覆盖的优先级。主色选 Black 时，浅色模式为黑、深色模式为白，高对比设置下也保持黑白；完整示例通过 Theme.WithBlackPrimary() 配置两个主题快照。
guide.en: The first button uses local component defaults, the second overrides its color, and the third customizes radius and horizontal padding through UI. Change the controls to compare global, local and instance styling. Select Black as the primary for black in light mode and white in dark mode, including high contrast. The complete example applies Theme.WithBlackPrimary() to both theme snapshots.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

body:
local := t.WithComponent(nui.ComponentButton, nui.ComponentTheme{Color: {{color}}, Size: {{size}}, Variant: {{variant}}})
nui.Button(c.Key("local"), local, "Local theme", nui.ButtonOptions{})
nui.Button(c.Key("override"), local, "Instance override", nui.ButtonOptions{Color: nui.Warning})
nui.Button(c.Key("parts"), t, "Part style override", nui.ButtonOptions{UI:nui.Styles{nui.Root:{Radius:nui.Set(float32(999)),PaddingX:nui.Set(float32(24))}}}).AlignSelf(ui.Start)

name: Container

description.zh: 限制内容宽度并提供水平留白。
description.en: Constrain content width and provide horizontal padding.

guide.zh: 调整 MaxWidth 和 Padding，再缩窄浏览器查看内容如何受到宽度约束。这些尺寸使用 DIP；通过 nui.Set(0) 可以明确取消留白，而不是使用未设置的默认值。
guide.en: Change MaxWidth and Padding, then narrow the browser to inspect the width constraint. Dimensions use DIP; nui.Set(0) explicitly removes padding instead of leaving its default unset.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

body: nui.Container(c.Key("container"), t, nui.ContainerOptions{MaxWidth: nui.Set(float32({{width}})), Padding: nui.Set(float32({{padding}}))}, func() { nui.Card(c.Key("card"), t, nui.CardOptions{Title:"Contained content"}, func(){ ui.Text(c,"Resize the browser to see the width constraint.") }) })

description.zh: 为主要内容提供应用布局区域。
description.en: Provide the main content region of an application.

guide.zh: Main 为主内容提供布局容器，示例中包含一张 Card。它可以和 Header、Sidebar、Footer 组合；业务内容通过同步回调构建。
guide.en: Main provides a layout container for primary content, shown here with a Card. Compose it with Header, Sidebar and Footer, and build application content in its synchronous callback.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

description.zh: 按需使用 Lucide 矢量图标。
description.en: Use Lucide vector icons on demand.

guide.zh: 选择 Lucide 图标并调整像素尺寸，预览直接绘制 SVG。完整示例展示图标包的按需导入；仅图标控件应提供能说明用途的 Label。
guide.en: Choose a Lucide icon and adjust its size to render the SVG directly. The complete example shows its package import; supply a meaningful Label for icon-only controls.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。

name: Button

description.zh: 触发操作，支持多种样式和状态。
description.en: Trigger actions with several appearances and states.

guide.zh: 点击按钮观察计数，再试试图标、Outline、LG、加载和禁用状态。操作计数保存在视图外，修改外观不会重复触发点击回调；重置会清除计数。
guide.en: Click the button to increment the counter, then try an icon, Outline, LG, loading and disabled states. The counter lives outside the view, so appearance changes do not repeat the callback; reset clears it.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

body:
nui.Button(c.Key("button"), t, {{label}}, nui.ButtonOptions{AccessibleLabel: cmp.Or({{label}}, "Example action"), Color: {{color}}, Size: {{size}}, Variant: {{variant}}, Disabled: {{disabled}}, Loading: {{loading}}, Leading: {{icon}}}).AlignSelf(ui.Start).OnClick(func(){s.Clicks++})
ui.Textf(c,"Clicked %d times",s.Clicks)

name: Link

description.zh: 用链接样式呈现导航与操作。
description.en: Present navigation and actions with link styling.

guide.zh: 点击链接更新下方计数，比较 Active 和 Disabled 外观。此例只触发本地回调；真实页面跳转或打开外部地址由应用在操作回调中实现。
guide.en: Activate the link to update the counter and compare Active and Disabled states. This example runs a local callback; application actions own navigation or opening external URLs.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

body:
nui.Link(c.Key("link"), t, {{label}}, nui.LinkOptions{Color: {{color}}, Disabled: {{disabled}}, Active: {{active}}}).OnClick(func(){s.Clicks++})
ui.Textf(c,"Activated %d times",s.Clicks)

description.zh: 为状态或数量提供紧凑标记。
description.en: Show a compact status or count.

guide.zh: 调整文字、图标、颜色和样式，比较适合状态说明与数量提示的效果。Badge 用来呈现信息；需要执行操作时可使用 Button。
guide.en: Change the text, icon, color and variant to compare status and count treatments. Badge presents information; use Button when an action is required.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

name: Card

description.zh: 组合标题、说明和主体内容。
description.en: Group a title, description and body content.

guide.zh: Card 将标题、说明和主体回调组合成一个区域。示例中的 Continue 按钮展示内容组合，尚未绑定业务操作；切换 Variant 比较卡片外观。
guide.en: Card combines a title, description and body callback. The Continue button illustrates composition without a business action; change Variant to compare the card treatments.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

body: nui.Card(c.Key("card"),t,nui.CardOptions{Title:{{label}},Description:"A native Go component",Variant:{{variant}}},func(){ui.Text(c,"A focused space for related content.");nui.Button(c.Key("action"),t,"Continue",nui.ButtonOptions{})})

description.zh: 突出重要信息和状态反馈。
description.en: Highlight important information and feedback.

guide.zh: 调整标题、语义颜色、样式与方向，观察图标和说明的排列。Alert 适合在内容区域持续解释状态；示例使用固定说明文字。
guide.en: Change the title, semantic color, variant and orientation to inspect the icon and description layout. Alert explains a persistent state in the content area; this example uses a fixed description.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

description.zh: 显示用户缩写或图标。
description.en: Display a person’s initials or icon.

guide.zh: 输入姓名查看缩写头像，并比较颜色与尺寸。此例通过 Alt 提供姓名；Text 为空时自动显示缩写，显式 Text 则原样显示。图片加载及应用用户资料由应用管理。
guide.en: Enter a name to inspect initials and compare colors and sizes. This example passes the name through Alt; an empty Text derives initials, while explicit Text is displayed literally. The application owns user data and image loading.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

description.zh: 叠放多个头像并显示溢出数量。
description.en: Stack avatars and show an overflow count.

guide.zh: 示例用三个稳定 ID 的用户展示头像叠放。修改 maximum 观察可见头像与溢出数量，动态列表应继续使用用户 ID，而不是列表索引。
guide.en: Three users with stable IDs demonstrate overlapping avatars. Change maximum to inspect visible avatars and overflow; dynamic collections should retain user IDs instead of list indexes.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

description.zh: 在内容角落附加状态标记。
description.en: Attach a small status indicator to content.

guide.zh: Chip 将小标记附在头像外侧，可用于数量或在线状态。切换 hidden 查看主体仍保留的效果，标记文字和颜色可独立于头像设置。
guide.en: Chip attaches a small count or status marker to an avatar. Toggle hidden to keep the underlying content visible, and configure the marker independently from the avatar.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

description.zh: 分隔内容，支持文字和方向。
description.en: Separate content with an optional label and orientation.

guide.zh: 切换横向与纵向分隔线，调整标签与颜色。分隔线的可见长度还取决于父布局；示例为方向切换预留了固定高度。
guide.en: Switch between horizontal and vertical separators and adjust the label and color. The parent layout also determines visible length; this example reserves height for both orientations.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

description.zh: 展示符合平台习惯的快捷键。
description.en: Display a platform-aware keyboard shortcut.

guide.zh: 这里显示 Ctrl + K 的按键提示，可修改尺寸与样式。Kbd 只负责呈现快捷键；真正的快捷键绑定需要由应用单独注册。
guide.en: This example displays a Ctrl + K hint with configurable size and variant. Kbd renders the hint; the application must register the actual shortcut separately.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

description.zh: 在加载期间保留内容布局。
description.en: Reserve content space while loading.

guide.zh: 修改宽高并切换 Animate，观察加载占位块。Skeleton 不会启动数据请求，应由应用根据加载状态显示；动画还会遵守减少动态效果设置。
guide.en: Change width, height and Animate to inspect a loading placeholder. Skeleton does not fetch data; show it from application loading state. Motion also respects reduced-motion preferences.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

description.zh: 显示任务进度或不确定加载状态。
description.en: Show task progress or an indeterminate loading state.

guide.zh: 调整 value 显示确定进度，或开启 Indeterminate 表示进度未知。此例由参数直接控制数值；真实任务应通过任务状态更新进度。
guide.en: Change value for determinate progress or enable Indeterminate when the amount is unknown. The controls supply the example value; real tasks should update progress through application state.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

description.zh: 展示任务各部分的进度占比。
description.en: Show the contributions of several progress segments.

guide.zh: 代码、测试和文档三段使用固定示例数据，可比较隐藏图例和方向变化。每段使用独立 ID、数值和语义颜色，便于连接任务数据。
guide.en: Code, tests and docs use fixed segment data. Compare the legend visibility and orientation; each segment has its own ID, value and semantic color for connecting task data.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

description.zh: 解释没有内容时的状态和下一步。
description.en: Explain an empty state and the next action.

guide.zh: 修改标题、尺寸与加载状态，比较空内容的呈现方式。示例的 Create project 按钮是操作区的组合示范，应用可在这里绑定创建流程。
guide.en: Change the title, size and loading state to compare empty-content presentations. The Create project button demonstrates the action area, where an application can start its creation flow.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

description.zh: 组合头像、姓名和用户说明。
description.en: Combine an avatar, name and description.

guide.zh: User 把头像、姓名和角色说明组合起来。切换 vertical 比较紧凑横排与纵排布局；姓名同时用于示例头像的缩写。
guide.en: User combines an avatar, name and role description. Toggle vertical to compare horizontal and stacked layouts; the example name also supplies avatar initials.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

name: Input

description.zh: 编辑单行文字并保留输入状态。
description.en: Edit a single line of text with persistent input state.

guide.zh: 在预览中输入内容，再修改尺寸、主题或语言，已输入的文字会保留。ReadOnly 允许读取但禁止编辑，Disabled 用于禁用控件；完整示例把字符串状态保存在视图外。
guide.en: Type in the preview, then change size, theme or language: the draft is preserved. ReadOnly prevents editing while Disabled disables the control; the complete program keeps the string outside the view.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

body:
nui.Input(c.Key("input"),t,&s.Value,nui.InputOptions{Label: {{label}}, Placeholder: {{placeholder}}, Color: {{color}}, Size: {{size}}, Variant: {{variant}}, Disabled: {{disabled}}, ReadOnly: {{readOnly}}, Loading: {{loading}}})
ui.Textf(c,"Value: %s",s.Value)

name: Textarea

description.zh: 编辑多行内容并可自动调整高度。
description.en: Edit multiline content with optional automatic sizing.

guide.zh: 输入多行文字并比较 Rows 与 AutoResize。Textarea 复用 InputOptions，文本状态需要在重建之间持久保存；增加行数不会重新初始化内容。
guide.en: Enter several lines and compare Rows with AutoResize. Textarea embeds InputOptions, and its text must persist across rebuilds; changing row count does not reinitialize the draft.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

body: nui.Textarea(c.Key("textarea"),t,&s.Value,nui.TextareaOptions{InputOptions:nui.InputOptions{Label: {{label}}, Placeholder: {{placeholder}}, Color: {{color}}, Size: {{size}}, Variant: {{variant}}, Disabled: {{disabled}}, ReadOnly: {{readOnly}}, Loading: {{loading}}},Rows:{{rows}},AutoResize:{{autoResize}}})

name: FormField

description.zh: 为控件添加标签、帮助和错误说明。
description.en: Associate a control with a label, help and errors.

guide.zh: 这个示例为 Input 添加标签、帮助、必填标记和可编辑的错误说明。将回调收到的主题继续传给输入框，可保持父字段与子控件的状态一致。
guide.en: This example wraps Input with a label, help, required marker and editable error text. Pass the callback theme to the input to keep field and child-control styling consistent.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

body: nui.FormField(c.Key("field"),t,nui.FormFieldOptions{Label:{{label}},Help:"Use a name your team will recognize.",Required:{{required}},Disabled:{{disabled}},Error:{{error}},Size:{{size}}},func(ft nui.Theme){nui.Input(c.Key("input"),ft,&s.Value,nui.InputOptions{Placeholder:"Project name"})})

description.zh: 将相关输入和操作组合为一组。
description.en: Group related inputs and actions.

guide.zh: 搜索输入与按钮通过 FieldGroupItem 组合，共用尺寸和禁用状态。切换 vertical 比较排列方式；每个项目使用稳定 ID，Build 只构建本次视图。
guide.en: FieldGroupItem combines a search input and button with shared size and disabled state. Toggle vertical to compare layouts; retain stable item IDs and use Build only for the current view.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

name: Checkbox

description.zh: 切换开关或选择状态。
description.en: Toggle a boolean selection or setting.

guide.zh: 点击复选框并观察 Enabled 的值；下方 CheckboxTri 展示混合选择状态。布尔值与三态值分别持久保存，修改颜色或文字不会清除选择。
guide.en: Toggle the checkbox and inspect Enabled; CheckboxTri below demonstrates a mixed selection. Boolean and tristate values persist independently, so appearance and label changes preserve selection.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

body:
nui.Checkbox(c.Key("toggle"),t,&s.Value,nui.CheckboxOptions{Label:{{label}},Description:"Updates are saved locally in this example.",Color:{{color}},Size:{{size}},Disabled:{{disabled}},Loading:{{loading}}})
ui.Textf(c,"Enabled: %t",s.Value)
nui.CheckboxTri(c.Key("tri"),t,&s.Mixed,nui.CheckboxTriOptions{CheckboxOptions:nui.CheckboxOptions{Label:"Mixed selection",Disabled:{{disabled}}}})

name: Switch

description.zh: 切换开关或选择状态。
description.en: Toggle a boolean selection or setting.

guide.zh: 切换开关查看 Enabled 的变化，再比较加载与禁用状态。示例只保存当前预览中的布尔值；需要保存到设置文件时，应在操作回调中执行。
guide.en: Toggle the switch and inspect Enabled, then compare loading and disabled states. The example holds a local boolean; saving a preference to storage belongs in an action callback.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

body:
nui.Switch(c.Key("toggle"),t,&s.Value,nui.SwitchOptions{Label:{{label}},Description:"Updates are saved locally in this example.",Color:{{color}},Size:{{size}},Disabled:{{disabled}},Loading:{{loading}}})
ui.Textf(c,"Enabled: %t",s.Value)

description.zh: 从一组选项中进行选择。
description.en: Choose from a group of related options.

guide.zh: 从语言列表中选择多个值，所选集合显示在下方。每个 Option 的 Value 是业务值，Label 是展示文字；改变横向布局不会重建选择数据。
guide.en: Select several languages and inspect the collection below. Option.Value is the business value and Label is display text; changing horizontal layout preserves the selection data.

note.zh: 参数表对应当前 Go API。默认选项通常继承主题；Optional 的未设置值与显式 false / 0 不同。
note.en: The API table describes the current Go library. Default options usually inherit the theme; unset Optional values differ from explicit false / 0.

description.zh: 从一组选项中进行选择。
description.en: Choose from a group of related options.

name: InputDate

description.zh: 按区域格式分段编辑日期，可选日历弹层。
description.en: Edit date segments in regional order, with an optional calendar.

guide.zh: 上方编辑单日，下方在同一外框内编辑日期范围。左右键切换字段，上下键增减，数字输入自动跳段；showCalendar 显式开启日历。值与未完成草稿分别保存。
guide.en: Edit a single date above and a range within one field below. Use arrows to navigate and increment segments; typing advances automatically. Enable showCalendar for a calendar. Values and incomplete drafts are retained separately.

note.zh: 日期／时间使用分段输入，Placeholder、Password 和 MaxLength 不适用。Style 的 editor 为首个分段。尚不支持分段撤销／重做、多历法或时区选择；浏览器预览不等同于原生读屏验证。 日历默认关闭，设置 ShowCalendar=true 开启；HideCalendar 优先关闭。
note.en: Date/time fields use segments; Placeholder, Password and MaxLength do not apply. The Style editor is the first segment. Segment undo/redo, alternative calendars and timezone selection are not supported; browser previews do not validate native screen readers. The calendar is off by default; enable ShowCalendar. HideCalendar takes precedence.

nui.InputDate(c.Key("date"),t,&s.Value,&s.Date,nui.InputDateOptions{InputOptions:nui.InputOptions{Label: {{label}}, Color: {{color}}, Size: {{size}}, Variant: {{variant}}, Disabled: {{disabled}}, ReadOnly: {{readOnly}}, Loading: {{loading}}},ShowCalendar:{{showCalendar}}})

guide.en: Edit hours, minutes, optional seconds and the day period. Use arrows to navigate and increment; A/P selects AM/PM. TimeInputState retains drafts and hidden seconds. Applications own timezone and date semantics.

note.zh: 日期／时间使用分段输入，Placeholder、Password 和 MaxLength 不适用。Style 的 editor 为首个分段。尚不支持分段撤销／重做、多历法或时区选择；浏览器预览不等同于原生读屏验证。 时间范围尚未提供。

guide.zh: 点击父节点选择并展开，方向键只移动高亮，Enter / Space 选择。开启 Multiple 后比较 toggle / replace、Shift 范围选择和父子联动；禁用项不会响应操作。 Nested 默认开启层级竖线及子项背景缩进；关闭后整行可点击，内容仍按层级缩进。切换模式保留选择、展开和滚动状态。
guide.en: Click a parent to select and expand. Arrow keys move the highlight; Enter / Space select. Enable Multiple to compare toggle / replace, Shift ranges and parent-child selection. Disabled items ignore input. Nested defaults to ancestor guides and inset child row backgrounds; turn it off for full-width clickable rows with indented content. Switching preserves selection, expansion and scrolling.

note.zh: 对照 Nuxt UI 4.12.0：默认单选，原生虚拟化始终开启。TreeState.Selection / Outline.Open 保存受控 ID；SetExpanded 可立即使折叠分支的加载票据失效。父子联动仅处理已加载节点，后续懒加载子项不自动继承选择。使用与迁移说明见仓库 docs/forms-data.md 的 Tree 章节。 Nested 对齐原生视觉布局；两种模式共用虚拟列表，不生成 Vue 嵌套 DOM。
note.en: Compared with Nuxt UI 4.12.0: single selection by default, native virtualization always enabled. TreeState.Selection / Outline.Open hold controlled IDs; SetExpanded immediately invalidates hidden loads. Propagation covers loaded nodes; later lazy children do not inherit selection. See the Tree section in docs/forms-data.md for usage and migration. Nested controls native visual layout; both modes share a virtual list, without Vue nested DOM.

description.zh: 组合可折叠、可调宽度的原生应用侧边栏。
description.en: Compose a collapsible, resizable application sidebar.

guide.zh: 拖动侧栏边缘调宽，双击边缘或点击 Reset width 恢复配置宽度。收起后悬停图标可查看提示，Settings 会打开侧向子菜单；选中项目会更新右侧页面。底部 Account 会随收起状态隐藏文字。可切换左右位置、关闭调宽或收起，并设置断点测试 Slideover、Modal、Drawer。
guide.en: Drag the sidebar edge to resize; double-click it or use Reset width to restore the configured width. Collapsed icons show tooltips, and Settings opens a side popover. Navigation updates the workspace; the Account footer hides its label when collapsed. Try either side, disable resizing or collapse, and set a breakpoint to test Slideover, Modal or Drawer.

note.zh: 展开宽度默认为 256 DIP，本例限制为 160–360 DIP，收起为 64 DIP。断点 0 保持桌面布局；设为大于预览区域宽度的值可显示打开按钮。弹层导航后自动关闭，桌面的收起状态与展开宽度保留。修改初始宽度不会覆盖已拖动的宽度，请点击 Reset width。状态持久化由应用负责。
note.en: The expanded width defaults to 256 DIP, constrained to 160–360 DIP in this example; collapsed width is 64 DIP. A zero breakpoint keeps desktop layout. Set it above the preview width to show the opener. Navigation closes the overlay while preserving desktop collapse and width. Changing the initial width does not replace a resized width: use Reset width. Persistence is application-owned.
